statement.zh: Zettler（1992）BBVO 11 基于发掘与档案材料研究尼普尔乌尔三朝伊南娜神庙的运作与组织。
statement.en: Zettler (1992) BBVO 11 studies the operation and organization of the Ur III Inanna temple at Nippur from excavation and archival evidence.
